subject: plyr 1.0 dlply - data.frame variable entries not carried over to list  names

messages.author: 6d91a9061453aa7b
messages.subject: plyr 1.0 dlply - data.frame variable entries not carried over to list  names
parts:
Hello,

I use dlply a lot to make a bunch of ggplots from my data frame, among
other things. I like to be able to refer to the elements in the
resulting list using the identifiers used to split the data. In plyr
0.1.9, the underlying entries of the variables used to split the data
were carried over as names of the resulting list. This is no longer
the case in plyr 1.0, as far as I can tell. Below is an example. The
two examples are from different workstations but that shouldn't make a
difference, I don't think.

## Test code
key<-rep(c("a","b"),each=2)
value<-c(1,2,3,4)
testdf<-data.frame(key,value)
testdl<-dlply(testdf,.(key),function(dfr) mean(dfr$value))

## plyr 0.1.9
> testdl
$a
[1] 1.5

$b
[1] 3.5

attr(,"split_type")
[1] "data.frame"
attr(,"split_labels")
key
1 a
2 b
> sessionInfo()
R version 2.11.1 Patched (2010-07-01 r52425)
i386-apple-darwin9.8.0

locale:
[1] en_CA.UTF-8/en_CA.UTF-8/C/C/en_CA.UTF-8/en_CA.UTF-8

attached base packages:
[1] stats graphics grDevices utils datasets methods
[7] base

other attached packages:
[1] plyr_0.1.9

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tools_2.11.1

## plyr 1.0
> testdl
[[1]]
[1] 1.5

[[2]]
[1] 3.5

attr(,"split_type")
[1] "data.frame"
attr(,"split_labels")
key
1 a
2 b
> sessionInfo()
R version 2.11.1 (2010-05-31)
x86_64-pc-linux-gnu

locale:
[1] LC_CTYPE=en_CA.UTF-8 LC_NUMERIC=C
[3] LC_TIME=en_CA.UTF-8 LC_COLLATE=en_CA.UTF-8
[5] LC_MONETARY=C LC_MESSAGES=en_CA.UTF-8
[7] LC_PAPER=en_CA.UTF-8 LC_NAME=C
[9] LC_ADDRESS=C LC_TELEPHONE=C
[11] LC_MEASUREMENT=en_CA.UTF-8 LC_IDENTIFICATION=C

attached base packages:
[1] stats graphics grDevices utils datasets methods base

other attached packages:
[1] plyr_1.0

It's a relatively easy fix for my workflow.
names(testdl)<-testdf$key

However, I was wondering if there was a reason for this change. I read
the changelog and didn't see anything that would indicate this.

Faisal

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: plyr 1.0 dlply - data.frame variable entries not carried over to  list names
parts:
Yes, it's a bug. The correct fix is:

names(testdl) <- attr(,"split_labels")[[1]]

or something along those lines.

Hadley
